Binary emissions pathway code (1.0 = RCP8.5 high-warming, 0.0 = RCP2.6 Paris mitigation)
GCM global mean annual surface temperature anomaly relative to pre-industrial (1850-1900)
Top-of-atmosphere net anthropogenic greenhouse radiative forcing trajectory at year t
Cumulative time-integral of radiative forcing from 2015 to year t (climate thermal memory)
Equilibrium Climate Sensitivity of driving CMIP5 general circulation model
Transient Climate Response of driving CMIP5 general circulation model
Cavity circulation regime (1.0 = Open cavity circulation, 0.0 = Standard non-local cavity)
Ocean thermal melt sensitivity multiplier factor gamma_0 / gamma_med (0.5 to 2.0)
Time-invariant grounded basin area from BedMachine V4.1 mask
Mean baseline grounded ice column thickness from BedMachine V4.1
Mean bedrock elevation at marine grounding line flux gates
Gravitational driving shear stress proxy from REMA + BedMachine
Fixed-effect indicator for Palmer Land West (Sector 16)
Fixed-effect indicator for Graham Land West (Sector 17)
